resources.string: Shows when SportLogger records an activity.
Tap to return to the active recording.
Allow activity, sensor, and location access to record.
Allow all-the-time sensor access in Settings to record heart rate after leaving SportLogger.
Recording paused after a lifecycle failure. Your activity was retained.
Your activity is retained, but SportLogger cannot safely restore controls yet.
Your activity is retained only while SportLogger keeps running because recovery metadata could not be saved. Keep the app open and retry recovery.
Recording did not start. No activity is in progress.
The recording action could not be completed.
